hooks.name: Aeolus Commit Format
hooks.description: Reminds the agent to follow conventional commit format and reference spec task IDs when committing code changes for the Aeolus project

action.prompt: Verify the commit message follows Conventional Commits format: type(scope): description. Valid types: feat, fix, refactor, docs, style, test, chore, perf, ci. Valid scopes: mqtt, devices, automations, api, dashboard, hue, docker, deps. Use imperative mood, keep subject under 72 chars, reference spec task IDs in the body when applicable. Each commit should be a single logical change. Also check if docs/COMPREHENSIVE_DOCUMENTATION.md needs updating.
